Chip parameters

brief · what you see on the map and in tooltips
# — chip number on board (C0…)
temp / °C — chip temperature
Freq — frequency, MHz
Vol — domain voltage, mV (Frequency mode only; from Miner API Log)
Nonce — nonce count found since mining start
Nonce/s — nonce / mining elapsed
Hash est — TH/s estimate: nonce share × ASIC hashrate
Nonce deficit — % below slot average nonce (−12% = weaker)
Gradient — °C hotter than upstream neighbors (local hotspot)
Outliers — hotter than same geometry on other boards (z-score; hydro M53/M63: mirrored boards reverse C#)
err — chip errors (API log)
crc — CRC link errors
x — xfer / transfer errors
r / repeat — repeat errors / repeats

Chip map polling

own interval · web admin · separate from live poll

Data from Miner API Log (not TCP :4028). Typically 4×264 chips. Empty password → miner API password is used. Server cache; UI reads cache.

Electricity tariff

price per kWh · day / night optional

Outside the night window the day rate applies. Night may cross midnight.

Peak / Semi-peak / Night — three rates.
Peak windows 1–2 — when Peak rate applies (same price in both).
Semi-peak — all other time. Priority: night → peak → semi-peak.

Used only for cost estimate. Does not control the miner.

Zone map · pool heating

Z0 High · Z1 Normal · Z2 Reduced · Z3 No heat · safety separate
T_ctrl = liquid · T_safe = chip max. Four heat zones; no deadband/hold. Hysteresis h prevents thrash at T0 / T1 / T2.

Map presets

save · apply · overwrite · delete

Thresholds (°C)

T_ctrl sensor · T0 · T1 · T2 · h · chip Critical

T_ctrl ≤ T0 → Z0 High · T0–T1 → Z1 Normal · T1–T2 → Z2 Reduced · T_ctrl ≥ T2 → Z3 No heat. Hysteresis h at T0 / T1 / T2 edges. T_safe (chip max) — separate.

T_ctrl scale (zone map)

needle = T_ctrl · T0 / T1 / T2 · zones Z0–Z3
20 24 26 28 35 40
Z0 High Z1 Normal Z2 Reduced Z3 No heat Safety (chip)

Z1 Normal heat T0 < liquid ≤ T1

Normal heat — operating mode.

⚠ mode restarts mining

Z2 Reduced heat T1 < liquid < T2

Reduced heat — target mid-range, not a hold.

⚠ mode restarts mining

Z3 No heat liquid ≥ T2

Do not add heat — water is warm enough.

Safety Critical · chip / T_safe T_safe ≥ T_crit

Not a pool zone. Above Z0–Z3. Metric = chip max. Two command sets: enter on T_crit and exit on T_crit_clear (→ Z2 Reduced).

Policy · anti-thrash

dwell · settle · streak · saved with zone map

Write only if the miner is not already at what the zone needs (mode / work / limit). Same zone + already correct mode — silence.

Warmup / upfreq gate

until ready — no point raising the profile

Saved with the anti-thrash Save button (same zone config). After max wait — upward allowed again even if upfreq is still 0.

Advanced settings

history · energy · devices poller · logs · chip map · rare options
History & charts
retention · sample interval · enable logging

After changing “Keep, days”, old points are removed on save. “Clear database” — delete all samples (charts go empty).

Energy metering
virtual kWh counter · hold power until next sample · energy.db

Virtual meter: current miner power is held until the next sample (ΔkWh = P × Δt). Tariff and reports: Miner → Energy. Physical meters are reserved for a future release.

—

Devices poller
status poll · desired / reported · Auto ON/OFF · isolated process

Interval — how often to poll each device (on/off, online, power…) and refresh reported state. Timeout — max wait per device I/O (hung plug). Backoff — skip a device for N sec after errors. Mining age — ignore stale mining_work if policy/history stopped. Per device: Enforce desired + Auto ON/OFF in Peripherals → Devices.

—

Logs depth
error log · event / action log ring size

Oldest entries beyond the limit are dropped on save and as new events arrive. Error log — miner_error_log (SQLite). Event log — policy / action log (disk).

—

Chip map · cache
disk cache · survives service restart

When enabled, after a successful LuCI poll the map is written to disk and reloaded on service start (stale until the next live poll). When off — cache file is deleted; only the current poll stays in RAM.

Access settings

Remote · auth · LuCI proxy :8788
Open LuCI
Remote · auth
poolheat UI access · do not port-forward :8787 to WAN

Do not raw port-forward :8787 to the Internet. Cloud + token; open forbidden with remote.

LuCI proxy · :8788
miner web UI via the router

Module luci_proxy: reverse-proxy to the miner (host from “Whatsminer connection”). Externally — plain HTTP :8788, to miner — HTTPS; cookies Secure/HSTS are stripped. Default off. Do not expose :8788 on WAN — LAN / VPN / Cloud only.

—

Miner sniffer
optional · download from GitHub · tcpdump on router
Download pcap
Install downloads modules/miner_sniffer from GitHub into the data directory.
Activate starts tcpdump on the router (requires module installed).
Deactivate stops capture but keeps the module on disk.
Uninstall removes module files and pcaps to free space.
Needs opkg install tcpdump.
Captures go to /tmp/poolheat-sniffer/ (tmpfs). Keep sessions short.
